name: pronto-studio
description: pronto's skills beyond its own plugin: intents (release, connect stripe, deploy), the Android host, Firebase Hosting, Google Cloud Run, social sign-in, the Unity host opt-in, journey monitoring, performance measurement, modular design (an app's spec split into modules, each exported alone), database migrations made from the emitted schema (columns paired by their proto field number), production log watching (prod-watch), self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, and the dev flow on a self-hosted Plane board (sprints, issues, bugs).
